newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dredger Boskalis order book at record.
newsitem.headline: Dredger Boskalis order book at record.

text.p: Dutch dredger Boskalis said on Thursday it won almost 200 million guilders in new orders in the first ten weeks of 1997, taking its total order book to a record 1.5 billion guilders.
"This is some 25 percent higher than the previous record of 1992, the year in which the Hong Kong airport contracts were awarded," Boskalis chairman Rob van Gelder said.
The difficult conditions in the dredging market in the second half of 1995 and first six months of last year had passed, he told a results news conference.
"I think the dip is over," he said.

Boskalis earlier reported 1996 profits down to 62.1 million guilders from the previous year's 70.9 million, but said it was maintaining its dividend at 1.10 guilders a share based on a bright outlook.
At the end of December 1996, the dredger's order book stood at 1.31 billion guilders, compared with 881 million guilders at the beginning of the year.
